scope: fixed material inference only, no retrieval/index changes, no training, no production changes

arms.purpose: deployed State reference, not pure model-size causal comparison

sampling: argmax, EOS 0, identical G1j no-think wrapper

scoring.termination: EOS vs length vs failed; never count unfinished as correct
scoring.facts: manual complete coverage, correct values, units, polarity, conditions, temporal scope
scoring.citations: each factual claim supported by the cited source; no fabricated labels
scoring.conflict: retain both mutually exclusive same-scope claims, no unjustified winner, no false conflict for scope differences
scoring.staged: exact quote validation and schema checks, semantic review separate
scoring.performance: wall time all calls, token counts from immutable server receipts; no speed claims from GPU-contended arms

limitations: synthetic and previously exposed regression cases, not blind commercial acceptance
staged is experimental narrow single-issue proof, not full automatic question planner or ingestion
oracle_quotes uses hand-selected verbatim spans as diagnostic upper control, not deployable automation
decision_rule: recommend model and architecture from complete per-case evidence; no automatic promotion or success thresholds inferred from these small fixtures
